main_body: round mud-brick hut with a conical thatched roof
top_band: yellow-gold conical thatched roof slope from row 0 to row 58 (around the doorway arch at row 48)
evidence: The structure clearly displays its large conical thatched roof from above (rows 0-58, or 0-48 above the central doorway) overhanging the vertical mud-brick walls below (rows 57-77). There is a distinct overhang edge, an eave shadow directly beneath the thatch (rows 59-61), and an inset dark doorway with inner framing.

style.evidence: The thatched roof features rich tiered straw detailing with ~6 distinct value steps across the cylinder/cone lighting ramp. The mud walls have brick patterning and multi-step cylinder shading, with dark brown material outlines rather than black.
